title: I want to play mobile games. Post it.
author: Need300dollars
selftext: Sometimes I overwhelm myself with making game so I want to relax and play a game and I only have my phone. Sincr I want to support AI games, I would love to check some mobile games made by this community. I won't play them all, though, it is as a pass time.

replies.author: Tall-Bicycle5298
replies.body:
Played it for a little bit. Its fun for a horde shooter. Pacing is nice. 

My complains though, the skill cards are too explainy. A damage up card shouldn't need to explain nothing changes on screen for a game like this unless its a +1 bullet. 

The skill "Cut and Run" should've probably just said -CC with an anecdote about special cases with the Kraken. I didnt get far enough yet to see how the effects are actually handled yet.

My nitpicks, I had to convince myself there was a guy singing sea shantys on my boat to get passed the vocals. Its not bad music. Just a touch different from the norm to include vocals during gameplay. 
(Theres only one in my game and its optional. The Playlist has a toggle. Only in there because of the person who does my music xD just wanted that out the way before anyone calls me a hypocrit)

My overall, its a decent take on a horde shooter. Ill probably figure to play it again soon.

replies.author: OneMoreCrew
replies.body: Yep good feedback thank you - the wordyness now you point it out is completely fair! Yer the music is a bit polarising I'd watched that Jason Segal movie where he writes the vampire puppet opera and I think my brain just went with that vibe 😅. I have got a toggle to change to standard procedural bit music in the settings but might make it a bit more obvious/ask the player at first load. Cheers mate!

replies.author: Need300dollars
replies.body:
The game was good but I didn't like useless text on cards, same thing the other review said. Overall, I found that the boss haves too much hp, that bored. But maybe you did it on purpose for another reason.
I said the game is good but, it feels not good, like visually is not appealing. Also the storm, looks procedural art.
I also nottice that the boss abilities, nit every one of them does dmg, like a bug.

replies.author: OneMoreCrew
replies.body: Yep got an improved look and design for the cards on the way. Hmm the boss health is interesting - as in the boss fight went too long? I guess I designed the bosses to be a bit of a barrier/accomplishment to overcome probably taking a few runs to beat with some Shipright upgrades rather than players just smashing through the game on their first try with no upgrades? Maybe I got that wrong? Storms and weather is procedural was it the art style you didn't like? Appreciate the feedback:)

replies.author: Need300dollars
replies.body:
The hurracane was good, but the lines that where below it simulating a whirlpool makes it disappointing. Better eliminate them, the hurracane will look good anyways or make a plane circle with shader on top of the ocean that simulates a whirlpool. It should use same shader/color of the ocean so it doesn't contrast.

The UI is not appealing visually. If it where me, I would make it paper like or wooden like, even flag like with animation of it included and background would be a boat instead of the ocean because it resambles "nothing is happening, let's take it easy" vibe. A boat unboard background would look good or even just a tavern like environment.
Also, since you change scenes everytime with too much tabs, would be good that each tab shows a different background even if it is in the same place, one tab can show the front of the ship and another shows the back... etc.

And, not letting players not smash on there first try... is not a bad idea. Actually, the game is well balanced, at least the minutes that I played it.

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body:
I’m working on a cosy tropical physics puzzle game: https://fishncrab-demo-v02.sidesliders.chatgpt.site/

There are 25 shells to collect 30+ animals to spot and working on the missions now. 2 of them are fully integrated.

Let me know your thoughts!

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body: surprisingly cute; pretty cool for a browser game

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body: Ok thanks. What did you like and what can be improved?

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body:
the environments are gorgeous; that's my favorite part.

If I had to be critical I'd focus in these areas:

1) music is a tad cheezy  
2) I'd love to see organisms react when engaged or bumped into  
3) the crab field of view is pretty limited with no upward visibility which feels limiting after playing with the fish

Here's the most critical piece and I say it with care. It's not very fun yet. Finding 5 sparkling stones is more a chore than a fantastical journey as the game stands. I'm definitely not motivated to find all of them. I'd much rather agitate sea creatures or something with immediate known benefit. As it stands, its a beautiful exploration demo.

It's a great start.

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body:
This is good feedback! 

1. The music is indeed to be improved  
2. This is a great idea! Will work on it  
3. The stones are being replaced by actual missions, did you try to interact with the sea turtle? That has the first mission. The plank on the sunken ship is the second. There will be 10 missions leading to a grand finale

replies.author: SignificanceFun550
replies.body:
I bumped into the sea turtle a few times.  I kept doing it because it looks pretty good!  But it didn't seem to react to me.

Happy to take a follow-up pass when you roll out some iterations.

replies.author: Need300dollars
replies.body:
Expectations overlap. It is intriguing because, even if it is a simple thing, the fact that you give new characters and new items making new strategies develop keeps it intriguing. But after some time, I got frustrated because it was slow, I wanted to be my turn fast, not wait until the monsters throw dice. My other frustration is that, in free play, I got counfused why I have this characters out of nowhere and when dying, I realize that everything I gathered just don't stay with me, it restarts. It was disappointing. The exp bar filling after completing a battle and wait to get the treasure chest to start next battle also is frustrating, like "I want to get the stuff fast and test them, not to see a movie". It is good to get amazed by the animation the first time, but everytime no.

What I would do:
Add a story, a map, and exploration to make your game richer in diversity and curiosity. I nottice that there where no ads. Add them, not as forced ads or I will never play your game again. But as rewarding ads is great.
Also microtransactions for legendary units, as piecies to make it harder. Also add shop where player can buy the cards, weapons, units, and even treasure chests of wooden, gold and dimond. Add that currency can be buyed with real money.

I'm sorry to speak my mind out, is just that I care for the game because of how well the tutorial was.

replies.author: kkostenkov
replies.body:
Wow. A very valuable feedback. Thank you so much. It contradicts with my philosophy about the game in terms of monetization and the weakest point so far I was considering a tutorial. (Like I never teach a very strong mechanic of taking back a move or what yellow HP should tell player)
Apart from that - great vector for the idea. Speed, smoothness and story. 
Thanks once again for your time and thoughts!

replies.author: PulIthEld
replies.body:
Shared stash:

- Rebirth moves your equipped items there.

- Every hero on the device can see it, in a new section of the Gear tab below the inventory.

- Tap an item there to take it into your inventory.

- Inventory items have a new "Send to shared stash" button, so you can save extras before you Rebirth. Anything left in the inventory is lost.

- It holds 60 items, and items are no longer salvaged on Rebirth.

replies.author: Need300dollars

The tutotial is just text in the middle of cards that have text with pop ups of texts of each turn. The tutorial, visually, is just a semi transparent black screen with white text. Is not the first thing you see when playing the game, it doesn't call attention. It also moves instantly at every action even if it is accidental and repeats same progress again and again. Also, the text in the cards are too small.

Maybe your talking of the in game learn to play advice, those are optional and can be switched of, its just for support if your uncertain what to do?
